diff --git a/monthly_report.py b/monthly_report.py
index fedd37b..438c54d 100644
--- a/monthly_report.py
+++ b/monthly_report.py
@@ -10,10 +10,29 @@ def monthly_totals(rows):
     return {month: round(totals[month], 2) for month in sorted(totals)}
 
 
+def change_label(prev, cur):
+    """Month-over-month change as text such as '+12.5%' or '-4.0%'.
+
+    prev is None for the first month ('-'). A zero previous total has no
+    defined change ('n/a'). The change is relative to abs(prev) so that a
+    move from -100 to -50 reads as an increase.
+    """
+    if prev is None:
+        return "-"
+    if prev == 0:
+        return "n/a"
+    value = round((cur - prev) / abs(prev) * 100, 1)
+    if value == 0:
+        value = 0.0  # avoid printing -0.0%
+    return f"{value:+.1f}%"
+
+
 def report_lines(rows):
-    lines = ["month        total"]
+    lines = ["month        total  change"]
+    prev = None
     for month, total in monthly_totals(rows).items():
-        lines.append(f"{month}  {total:>11.2f}")
+        lines.append(f"{month}  {total:>11.2f}  {change_label(prev, total):>7}")
+        prev = total
     return lines
 
 
diff --git a/tests/test_monthly_report.py b/tests/test_monthly_report.py
index 991d87b..4dacc36 100644
--- a/tests/test_monthly_report.py
+++ b/tests/test_monthly_report.py
@@ -3,6 +3,11 @@ from monthly_report import monthly_totals, report_lines
 ROWS = [("2026-01-05", 120.0), ("2026-01-20", 80.0), ("2026-02-03", 55.5)]
 
 
+def changes(rows):
+    """The change column (third token) for each month line."""
+    return [line.split()[2] for line in report_lines(rows)[1:]]
+
+
 def test_monthly_totals_in_order():
     assert monthly_totals(ROWS) == {"2026-01": 200.0, "2026-02": 55.5}
 
@@ -12,3 +17,31 @@ def test_report_has_a_line_per_month():
     assert lines[0].split()[:2] == ["month", "total"]
     assert lines[1].split()[:2] == ["2026-01", "200.00"]
     assert lines[2].split()[:2] == ["2026-02", "55.50"]
+
+
+def test_header_has_change_column():
+    assert report_lines(ROWS)[0].split() == ["month", "total", "change"]
+
+
+def test_first_month_gets_a_dash():
+    assert changes(ROWS)[0] == "-"
+
+
+def test_up_and_down_changes_one_decimal():
+    rows = [("2026-01-10", 200.0), ("2026-02-10", 225.0), ("2026-03-10", 216.0)]
+    assert changes(rows) == ["-", "+12.5%", "-4.0%"]
+
+
+def test_zero_previous_month_is_not_a_number():
+    rows = [("2026-01-10", 0.0), ("2026-02-10", 50.0)]
+    assert changes(rows) == ["-", "n/a"]
+
+
+def test_negative_previous_month_uses_absolute_base():
+    rows = [("2026-01-10", -100.0), ("2026-02-10", -50.0)]
+    assert changes(rows) == ["-", "+50.0%"]
+
+
+def test_no_change_prints_plus_zero():
+    rows = [("2026-01-10", 100.0), ("2026-02-10", 100.0)]
+    assert changes(rows) == ["-", "+0.0%"]
